name: ost-pyth-crank
description: Isolated dependency graph for the Pyth-verified market crank. The Pyth receiver SDK pulls jito-ts -> an OLD @solana/web3.js that needs rpc-websockets@7, while the main repo uses web3 1.98 which needs rpc-websockets@9. Those cannot coexist in one node_modules (pinning either one breaks the other — verified). Isolating the crank here lets npm nest both correctly instead of masking the conflict with a global override.
